market.what: Ni/Co/Mn separation circuits (SX reagents + SX capex charge) in black-mass hydromet plants, world (~88% Asia)
market.method: bottom-up est.: ~600 kt Ni/Co black mass refined (120 kt Ni at ~20% Ni) x ~$735/t separation cost [opex ~$340/t: NaOH saponification ~440 kg x $368/t, strip acid ~540 kg x $123/t, Na2SO4 handling, organic loss; capex charge ~$395/t: 35% SX share x 15%/yr of ~$5k/t-yr Asia or ~$26k/t-yr West (Li-Cycle $0.85-1B/35 kt)]; cross-check ~11% of ~$4.0B recovered metal value

value.logic: regenerable one-metal-at-a-time binder replaces SX train: 40% cut of $440M separation cost (no saponification/Na2SO4, fewer stages, no flammable organic) = $176M + 0.5% more Ni/Co/Li of $4.0B = $20M
value.revenue_logic: yr 7 (2032) volumes x2.66 (15%/yr): $195M x 2.66 x 6% adoption (West/Korea new builds, Refinyx-type licensors) x 35% capture as binder sales + licence fee
value.margin_logic: specialty regenerable ligand/sorbent plus some royalty; resin-type COGS

trend.drivers: black mass refined grows to 2.1 Mt by 2034; recycled Ni 112->493 kt, Co 30->121 kt 2024-34; EU recovery and recycled-content rules
trend.deadline: EU Battery Reg 2023/1542: 90% Ni/Co and 50% Li recovery by 31 Dec 2027

incumbents: Chinese recyclers in-house SX (Brunp/CATL, GEM, Huayou)
competition.paper_query: nickel cobalt manganese separation battery leachate
competition.notes: SX with P204/P507/Cyanex is entrenched in China; RefinyX (ex-Northvolt Revolt team) sells a solvent-free flowsheet = natural partner; Ascend raised $542M equity + $480M DOE grants; Nth Cycle $44M Series B; cylib EUR55M Series A 2024

lab.synth: macrocycle/polymer/grafted resin: 3 ligands (Ni, Co, Mn selective) grafted on silica/resin, 2-3 variants each
lab.test: batch isotherms + selectivity in synthetic and real NMC leach (pH 1-5), column breakthrough/elution 3 cycles, ICP-OES; university hydromet lab (Chalmers, Aalto) or SGS/KPM
lab.logic: synth 14 wk + test 6 wk; grafted resins ~$50k + ~400 ICP-OES samples x $40-50 = $20k + black mass, columns, leach work ~$15k

sale.gates: continuous bench on real leach 3-6 mo; pilot at recycler/licensor 6-12 mo; pCAM buyer qualifies NiSO4/CoSO4 6-12 mo
